name: AE Member Enrollment Operational Dashboard
description: Working-team dashboard for Member Annual Enrollment: full Enrollment Status breakdown by Wave, election-detail counts/averages (HSA/FSA/Supplemental Life/Retirement/Vision), and a waiver trend by membership type (Sponsored vs. Retired). Split off from AE Member Enrollment (Snap) on 2026-09-22, same suite structure as the Employer Election family.

feeds.description: Wave / Enrollment Status / Defaulted / Defaulted Timing — same DS_MEMBER_ENROLLMENT_SUMMARY cube the Snap widget (sac-member-enrollment-widget) binds to, rendered here as a full per-Wave status breakdown instead of just Set Up/Completed headline tiles.

Member Count, Multiple-Attempts Member Count, Total Eligible Lives, Total Covered Lives (last two added 2026-09-22 -- current-snapshot family-size counts from vDimMember's EligibleCount/HealthCoveredCount, member plus eligible/covered dependents; NOT a year-over-year trend -- true YoY volume trending is a separate ongoing effort with Ahmed)
EventDate (cycle) / Membership Type (Sponsored / Retired / Other) — DS_MEMBER_WAIVER_TREND, unscoped by cycle so both years are present for the trend

refresh.description: Re-renders the dashboard from the currently bound data
